nodes.label: Content scripts never auto-deployed
nodes.rationale: seo/*.php rewrite post_content and would overwrite wp-admin edits; run only via workflow_dispatch with run_content_scripts or manually.

nodes.label: seo/deploy.sh single deploy recipe
nodes.rationale: Same recipe used by GitHub Actions and terminal: backup, theme, content scripts, cache purge, cache warm, URL verification.

nodes.label: deploy.sh script ordering rule
nodes.rationale: prices after treatments; content-fixes and design-fixes last because sculptra-cdmx.php rewrites the hub.

nodes.label: Use $wpdb->update not wp_update_post
nodes.rationale: kses breaks shortcodes in wp_update_post; each script ends with a self-check.

nodes.label: Dedicated CI SSH key + pinned known_hosts
nodes.norm_label: dedicated ci ssh key + pinned known_hosts
nodes.rationale: No ssh-keyscan to avoid blindly accepting server key.

nodes.label: Theme and content deployed separately
nodes.rationale: seo/*.php rewrite post_content; repeating them each push would erase wp-admin edits.

nodes.label: Deploy decisions (single recipe, theme-only on push)
nodes.norm_label: deploy decisions (single recipe, theme-only on push)
nodes.rationale: Content scripts overwrite wp-admin edits, so only manual runs.

nodes.label: Botox duration unified to 3-5 months
nodes.rationale: User decision to match /botox-cdmx/; fixed FAQ and SASWP FAQ schema via content-fixes.php.

nodes.label: GA4 not comparable (measurement change 16 Oct)
nodes.rationale: Own GTM and single gtag from 16 Oct plus unexcluded internal traffic inflate sessions; GA4 is baseline only from 16 Oct.

nodes.rationale: Without it first visits incl. Googlebot wait 1-2 s; a cold sitemap took 90 s.
